tbesh_html:
Zoba or Zobah = "station"
the name of a portion of Syria which formed a separate kingdom in the times of Saul, David, and Solomon; located northeast of Damascus
Another name of tso.va (צוֹבָא "Zobah" H6678G)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Zoba or Zobah, a region of Syria
strongs_1890.derivation: or צוֹבָה; or צֹבָה; from an unused root meaning to station; a station;
